The recorded outputs settle it — 'Your new reporting dashboard is live' with an exclamation mark appended is one edit away and still fails. The other three failures are the ordinary anti-pattern of pinning exact or near-exact text onto generated copy (equals on a full JSON envelope, contains on 'Save 20%' when the model writes 'save 20%' and '20% off', rouge-n at 0.95 on a one-line subject), and those want semantic or model-graded assertions. The three javascript checks and is-json are determinate structural facts with 0 failures across the whole window and must stay deterministic; sweeping them into a rubric is the mirror-image failure and destroys the only part of the suite the owner trusts.
